body:
## Module 1 in two minutes

**L&D work runs a chain:** request → diagnosis → design → production → delivery → transfer → evidence. Your hours have always concentrated in the middle three. Your distinctive value has always sat at the two ends: deciding what is worth building, and proving it did anything.

**AI collapsed the middle.** Which promotes the two things this field has historically been worst at into the entire job.

**And the diagnosis here runs opposite to every other People track's** `[V]`. The business partner is told their core territory is the least AI-penetrated part of HR. Yours is among the most: L&D is third of sixteen practice areas for reported AI use at 17%, and roughly 71% of L&D professionals report experimenting or integrating. The saturation is in your craft, and you brought it there yourselves. (Honest caveat, since this module asks you to interrogate evidence: "use cases" isn't "work replaced," and "experimenting or integrating" is a generous bucket. The narrow claim is enough.)

**The triage, in order: cheap now / ours only / needs a human on the hook.** Run question one as harshly as you can, then rescue only what genuinely answers two or three. Reversing the order makes everything look human-critical.

**What protects bucket two is that the information is undocumented**, not that the judgment is subtle. Those are different claims, and the second comes with a condition: it holds exactly as long as the documentation gap does.

## The rule

**Question one asks what it costs to replace the thing today, not what it cost you to make.**

"But that took my team six weeks" is a fact about the past and isn't an answer to the triage. The most common way a portfolio review fails is that it defends the hours rather than the value.

## What the full module adds

The seven-stage chain worked through with your own hours against it. The adoption evidence with its caveats stated. The twelve-item sorting exercise, including the three cards that are genuinely arguable. What would have to become true for bucket two to halve, and why the answer is uncomfortable. The three modules this track refuses to teach, and where they already live. And the activity: your real catalog triaged, two boundaries defended, and **one program you would stop.**
